criteria.description: Bundled processed TLC files match their inventory and cover all 36 months
Train, validation and full test periods are nonempty and separated by the label embargo
Training records a CUDA GPU and CUDA-enabled PyTorch
Finite training and validation losses and the best-validation TGN checkpoint are present
The complete test interval is evaluated and bound to the saved checkpoint
All models use the same candidates and the saved MRR is independently recomputed
Saved observed counts match the supplied held-out TLC data
Assessment and report are present and agree with the metrics
